newsitem.title: USA: Polk County, Fla., mulls $27 mln road bonds.
newsitem.headline: Polk County, Fla., mulls $27 mln road bonds.

text.p: Florida's Polk County Commission has proposed refunding $14 million of outstanding revenue bonds and issuing about $13 million of new money bonds to pay for road repairs, assistant county auditor Barbara Smith said Wednesday.
However, Smith said, "It's still in the planning stage. Nothing is set."
The refunding would refinance several existing issues. If the deal is approved by county commissioners, the bond would probably be sold in early December.
